scope: All cleaned merchandise; 2009-12-01 through 2011-12-08; all countries

findings.text: January–November 2011 positive-sales value changed by +2.90% versus the same months in 2010; units changed by -6.00%.
findings.formula: 100 × (current / previous − 1), calculated separately for value and units
findings.limitations: Matched complete January–November periods; value and unit changes do not establish price, mix, or causal explanations.
findings.population: All cleaned positive merchandise sales; all countries
findings.value_basis: Transaction-level Quantity × Price, summed before aggregation; returns excluded

findings.text: 22423 (REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER) led positive-sales value at £330,757.09, accounting for 1.70% of the all-merchandise total.
findings.formula: sum(transaction Quantity × Price); share = 100 × product value / all-merchandise value
findings.limitations: Ranking is by observed positive-sales value across the extract, not profit, net revenue, or customer preference.
findings.population: All cleaned positive merchandise sales; all countries
findings.value_basis: Transaction-level Quantity × Price, summed before aggregation; returns excluded

findings.text: Thursday had the highest average daily positive-sales value: £37,923.16 over 106 covered calendar days, including zero-sales dates.
findings.formula: weekday positive_sales_gbp / covered_calendar_days, including zero-sale dates
findings.limitations: Covered calendar days include zeros; zero observations cannot distinguish closure, missing records, or stock-outs.
findings.population: All cleaned positive merchandise sales; all countries
findings.value_basis: Transaction-level Quantity × Price, summed before aggregation; returns excluded
